<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use CoreX\Config\Exceptions\InvalidConfiguration;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Bootstrappers\CachePrefixBootstrapper;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Bootstrappers\ConnectionBootstrapper;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Bootstrappers\SessionConnectionBootstrapper;

/**
 * @return array{0: array<string, mixed>, 1: array<string, mixed>}
 */
function validTenancyConfigArrays(): array
{
    return [
        [
            'central_connection' => 'pgsql',
            'bootstrappers' => [ConnectionBootstrapper::class, CachePrefixBootstrapper::class, SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class],
            'cache_prefix' => 'tenant_%tenant%_',
            'cache_stores' => ['tenant_file'],
            'storage' => [
                'durable_driver' => 'local',
                'durable_root' => '/tmp/durable',
                'ephemeral_root' => '/tmp/ephemeral',
            ],
            'host_identification' => [
                'enabled' => false,
                'cache' => true,
                'cache_ttl' => 300,
                'cache_store' => null,
            ],
            'domain_trust' => [
                'enabled' => false,
                'challenge_ttl_seconds' => 300,
            ],
            'status_gate' => [
                'payment_route' => null,
                'export_route' => null,
                'read_only_methods' => ['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'],
            ],
            'oidc' => [
                'enabled' => false,
                'guard' => 'web',
                'allowed_algs' => ['RS256'],
                'leeway_seconds' => 30,
                'discovery' => ['cache_ttl' => 3600],
                'jwks' => [
                    'cache_ttl' => 3600,
                    'refetch_cooldown_seconds' => 60,
                ],
                'impersonation' => [
                    'enabled' => false,
                    'require_approved_by' => false,
                ],
                'max_session_lifetime_minutes' => 720,
            ],
            'workspace' => ['path_segment' => 'w'],
            'trial_days' => 14,
            'grace_days' => 30,
            'platform_domain' => 'example.test',
            'template_integrity' => [
                'trusted_keys' => [],
                'manifests' => [],
            ],
        ],
        [
            'wakeup' => [
                'driver' => 'local_sweep',
                'root_connection' => 'pgsql',
                'lease_seconds' => 60,
            ],
        ],
    ];
}

it('builds options from a valid tenancy snapshot', function (): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();

    $options = TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);

    expect($options->centralConnection)->toBe('pgsql')
        ->and($options->wakeupDriver)->toBe('local_sweep')
        ->and($options->statusGate->readOnlyMethods)->toBe(['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']);
});

it('rejects oidc enabled without client secret', function (): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();
    $tenancy['oidc'] = [
        ...$tenancy['oidc'],
        'enabled' => true,
        'issuer' => 'https://issuer.example',
        'client_id' => 'client',
        'redirect_uri' => 'https://app.example/callback',
        'client_secret' => null,
    ];

    try {
        TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);
        $this->fail('Invalid configuration was accepted.');
    } catch (InvalidConfiguration $exception) {
        expect($exception->violations)->toContain(
            'oidc.client_secret: must be present when oidc.enabled is true',
        );
    }
});

it('rejects root_registry wakeup without root connection', function (): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();
    $corexTenancy['wakeup'] = [
        ...$corexTenancy['wakeup'],
        'driver' => 'root_registry',
        'root_connection' => '',
    ];

    try {
        TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);
        $this->fail('Invalid configuration was accepted.');
    } catch (InvalidConfiguration $exception) {
        expect($exception->violations)->toContain(
            'wakeup.root_connection: must be non-empty when wakeup.driver is root_registry',
        );
    }
});

it('accumulates oidc and wakeup violations in one exception', function (): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();
    $tenancy['oidc'] = [
        ...$tenancy['oidc'],
        'enabled' => true,
        'issuer' => 'https://issuer.example',
        'client_id' => 'client',
        'redirect_uri' => 'https://app.example/callback',
        'client_secret' => '',
    ];
    $corexTenancy['wakeup'] = [
        ...$corexTenancy['wakeup'],
        'driver' => 'root_registry',
        'root_connection' => '',
    ];

    try {
        TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);
        $this->fail('Invalid configuration was accepted.');
    } catch (InvalidConfiguration $exception) {
        expect($exception->violations)->toHaveCount(2)
            ->and($exception->violations)->toContain(
                'oidc.client_secret: must be present when oidc.enabled is true',
                'wakeup.root_connection: must be non-empty when wakeup.driver is root_registry',
            );
    }
});

it('exposes the closed stock bootstrapper order, tenant cache stores and the host cache settings', function (): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();

    $options = TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);

    expect($options->bootstrappers)->toBe([ConnectionBootstrapper::class, CachePrefixBootstrapper::class, SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class])
        ->and($options->cacheStores)->toBe(['tenant_file'])
        ->and($options->hostCache)->toBeTrue()
        ->and($options->hostCacheTtl)->toBe(300)
        ->and($options->hostCacheStore)->toBeNull();
});

it('rejects bootstrapper lists that break the closed order', function (array $list, string $path): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();
    $tenancy['bootstrappers'] = $list;

    try {
        TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);
        $this->fail('Invalid configuration was accepted.');
    } catch (InvalidConfiguration $exception) {
        expect(implode("\n", $exception->violations))->toContain($path);
    }
})->with([
    'connection not first' => [[CachePrefixBootstrapper::class, ConnectionBootstrapper::class], 'corex-tenancy.bootstrappers.0'],
    'stock order swapped' => [[ConnectionBootstrapper::class, SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class, CachePrefixBootstrapper::class], 'corex-tenancy.bootstrappers.2'],
    'stock after a host class' => [[ConnectionBootstrapper::class, stdClass::class, CachePrefixBootstrapper::class], 'corex-tenancy.bootstrappers.1'],
    'duplicate' => [[ConnectionBootstrapper::class, ConnectionBootstrapper::class], 'corex-tenancy.bootstrappers.1'],
    'empty' => [[], 'corex-tenancy.bootstrappers'],
]);

it('rejects a cache prefix without %tenant%, duplicate stores and a host store that is also a tenant store', function (): void {
    [$tenancy, $corexTenancy] = validTenancyConfigArrays();
    $tenancy['cache_prefix'] = 'static_';
    $tenancy['cache_stores'] = ['a', 'a'];
    $tenancy['host_identification']['cache_store'] = 'a';

    try {
        TenancyOptions::fromArray([...$tenancy, ...$corexTenancy]);
        $this->fail('Invalid configuration was accepted.');
    } catch (InvalidConfiguration $exception) {
        expect($exception->violations)->toContain(
            'corex-tenancy.cache_prefix: must contain %tenant%',
            'corex-tenancy.cache_stores.1: must be unique',
            'corex-tenancy.host_identification.cache_store: must not be one of cache_stores',
        );
    }
});

availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead.  * Immutable reference to an account: identity, slug, lifecycle status, and

 *
 * Contract: B-10 §3.1, B-11 §3.1 (owner: B-11).

#[Api(since: '1.0')]
final readonly class AccountRef
{
    /**

     * @param  array<string, int|string|bool>  $limits

        public string $id,
        public string $slug,
        public string $status,
        public array $features,
        public array $limits,
    ) {}
}

Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. availableCommands.name: setup-writing-style
availableCommands.description: Learns how the user writes from their own sent messages and docs, and builds a voice profile so future drafts sound like them instead of generic AI. The profile is saved as the my-writing-style skill. Use when the user asks to set up, learn, or capture their writing voice, or complains that drafts sound generic or unlike them and no my-writing-style profile exists. Only for drafting text the user will send as themselves, not for Claude's own replies.

A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.

availableCommands.description: Required reading before you start, watch, or wait on anything that keeps running after you launch it — background jobs, watchers, scheduled loops, CI, pull requests, training runs, dev servers, long builds. Read it before you launch such work and before you report on its state. Saying where a running job stands counts as working on it. Use when: about to launch, supervise, inspect, diagnose, or report on work that keeps running after it is started.

availableCommands.name: pr-babysit

availableCommands.description: Run a reviewer subagent against your whole branch vs main, your uncommitted working state, a named branch, a single GitHub PR, or an entire Graphite/stacked-PR stack (one reviewer subagent per PR). A bare /review defaults to reviewing your uncommitted working state when the tree is dirty, or your whole branch vs main when the tree is clean. Main, local, and branch modes write a review file plus a summary to disk. PR and stack modes post the findings as a PENDING GitHub review for the user to inspect and submit through the UI. Use --main for an explicit clean-tree branch review, --stack for stacked PRs, --submit to publish immediately as COMMENT, or --approve to publish and approve; the default remains PENDING.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Commands;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Identity\Contracts\IdentitySyncer;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Control-plane sweep (B-11 §3.2): re-syncs every `root_identity_accounts`
 * row that is `failed`/`pending`, or whose `synced_at` has fallen behind its
 * identity's `updated_at` — the retry path for {@see IdentitySyncer}'s
 * per-account failure isolation (AC-16 з).
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class IdentitiesReconcileCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'corex:tenancy:reconcile-identities';

    protected $description = 'Re-sync failed, pending, and stale identity projections into their account users tables.';

    public function handle(IdentitySyncer $syncer, ?TenancyOptions $options = null): int
    {
        $centralConnection = ($options ?? $this->laravel->make(TenancyOptions::class))->centralConnection;

        $rows = DB::connection($centralConnection)
            ->table('root_identity_accounts as ria')
            ->join('root_identities as ri', 'ri.id', '=', 'ria.identity_id')
            ->where(function ($query): void {
                $query->whereIn('ria.sync_status', ['failed', 'pending'])
                    ->orWhereColumn('ria.synced_at', '<', 'ri.updated_at');
            })
            ->select('ria.identity_id', 'ria.account_id')
            ->get();

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $syncer->syncToAccount((string) $row->identity_id, (string) $row->account_id);
        }

        $this->components->info(sprintf('Reconciled %d identity/account pair(s).', $rows->count()));

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Commands;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\PendingPool;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

/**
 * Keeps `root_clusters.pending_pool_size` pre-cloned account databases
 * ready per cell (AC-4, B-11 §5.2). Without `--count`, tops each targeted
 * cluster up to its own `pending_pool_size` (steady-state/cron usage);
 * `--count=N` overrides with an explicit number (ad hoc seeding).
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class PendingCreateCommand extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'corex:tenancy:pending-create {--count=} {--cluster=}';

    protected $description = 'Top up (or explicitly seed) the pending account pool for one or all active clusters.';

    public function handle(PendingPool $pool, ?TenancyOptions $options = null): int
    {
        $centralConnection = ($options ?? $this->laravel->make(TenancyOptions::class))->centralConnection;
        $explicitCount = $this->option('count') !== null ? (int) $this->option('count') : null;
        $clusterId = $this->option('cluster');

        $clusters = $clusterId !== null
            ? [$clusterId]
            : DB::connection($centralConnection)
                ->table('root_clusters')
                ->where('status', 'active')
                ->pluck('id')
                ->all();

        foreach ($clusters as $id) {
            $count = $explicitCount ?? $this->topUpCount($centralConnection, $pool, (string) $id);

            if ($count <= 0) {
                continue;
            }

            $created = $pool->createPending($count, (string) $id);

            $this->components->info(sprintf('Cluster [%s]: created %d pending account(s).', $id, count($created)));
        }

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function topUpCount(string $centralConnection, PendingPool $pool, string $clusterId): int
    {
        $poolSize = (int) DB::connection($centralConnection)
            ->table('root_clusters')
            ->where('id', $clusterId)
            ->value('pending_pool_size');

        return max(0, $poolSize - $pool->pendingCount($clusterId));
    }
}

1→# CoreX

Модульное ядро на Laravel (MIT), на котором собираются продукты Flex-экосистемы (FlexCRM, FlexCMS,
FlexStore) без переписывания фундамента. Монорепо: разработка здесь, публикация — read-only зеркалами
по пакету (см. [[ADR-002 Monorepo]]).

## Пакеты

| Пакет | Назначение | Документация |
10→|---|---|---|
| `axiomasoft/corex-access` | CoreX auth bridge — tenant-boundary authorization, entity-context checks and scoped Blade directives on top of AzGuard (ADR-009). | [access](packages/access/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex` | CoreX kernel — base model (ULID), optional multi-tenancy, entity registry, settings, audit log, and money for any Laravel application. | [core](packages/core/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-custom-fields` | Typed attribute ports and safe schema-operation bridge for CoreX. | [custom-fields](packages/custom-fields/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-intl` | Typed locale, money/rate snapshots, and offline geography reference utilities for CoreX. | [intl](packages/intl/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-media` | Tenant-scoped private media lifecycle primitives for CoreX. | [media](packages/media/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-notifications` | Durable tenant-scoped notification primitives for CoreX. | [notifications](packages/notifications/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-operations` | Opt-in module operation dispatch, trusted context contracts and OpenAPI projection for Laravel. | [operations](packages/operations/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-panels` | Headless panel descriptors and current-context access catalogue for CoreX modules. | [panels](packages/panels/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-recurrence` | Bounded RFC 5545 recurrence expansion for CoreX consumers. | [recurrence](packages/recurrence/README.md) |
20→| `axiomasoft/corex-search` | Typed, policy-hydrated search boundary for CoreX. | [search](packages/search/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-search-intl` | Optional localized projection glue between axiomasoft/corex-intl and axiomasoft/corex-search. | [search-intl](packages/search-intl/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-search-meilisearch` | Optional Meilisearch candidate adapter for axiomasoft/corex-search. | [search-meilisearch](packages/search-meilisearch/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-tasks` | CoreX Tasks module — workspace projects, stages and tasks for DB-per-account applications. | [tasks](packages/tasks/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-tasks-workflow` | Recurrence-to-task materialization for CoreX with durable wakeup and optional workflow capture. | [tasks-workflow](packages/tasks-workflow/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-tenancy` | CoreX physical DB-per-account tenancy — root-schema control plane on stancl/tenancy v4 (B-11, D13). | [tenancy](packages/tenancy/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-tools` | Guarded tool runtime for CoreX operations: schemas, contract hash and MCP projection. | [tools](packages/tools/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-transfer` | Bounded import and export primitives for CoreX. | [transfer](packages/transfer/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-wakeup` | Durable local wakeup requests for CoreX modules. | [wakeup](packages/wakeup/README.md) |
| `axiomasoft/corex-webhooks` | Webhook subscriptions, signing, delivery and replay for CoreX operations. | [webhooks](packages/webhooks/README.md) |
30→| `axiomasoft/corex-workflow` | Optional durable workflow engine binding for CoreX modules. | [workflow](packages/workflow/README.md) |
| `flex/crm` | Продукт FlexCRM поверх CoreX | [flex-crm](products/flex-crm/README.md) |

Установка ядра: `composer require axiomasoft/corex`. Конфигурация публикуется командой

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal;

use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data\NormalizedHost;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Exceptions\TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Factory as CacheFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use InvalidArgumentException;

/**
 * Resolves `Request::getHost()` to an account id through `root_domains` (verified, not deleted)
 * and `root_accounts` (not deleted, slug set — §7.3 п.9: a pending shell has neither a verified
 * domain nor a slug, so it is unreachable by host). The cache holds the account id only and
 * never a miss; it lives in the explicit host store, outside the tenant cache stores.
 */
final readonly class HostAccountResolver
{
    public function __construct(
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private CacheFactory $cache,
        private TenancyOptions $options,
    ) {}

    /** @return string account id */
    public function resolve(string $host): string
    {
        $host = self::normalizeHost($host);
        $store = $this->cache->store($this->options->hostCacheStore);
        $id = $this->options->hostCache ? $store->get(self::key($host)) : null;

        if (! is_string($id)) {
            $id = $this->lookup($host);

            if ($id !== null && $this->options->hostCache) {
                $store->put(self::key($host), $id, $this->options->hostCacheTtl);
            }
        }

        return $id ?? throw TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException::forHost($host);
    }

    public static function key(string $host): string
    {
        return 'corex-tenancy:host:'.$host;
    }

    public static function normalizeHost(string $host): string
    {
        try {
            return (new NormalizedHost($host))->value;
        } catch (InvalidArgumentException) {
            throw TenantCouldNotBeIdentifiedByHostException::forHost($host);
        }
    }

    private function lookup(string $host): ?string
    {
        $id = $this->connections->connection($this->options->centralConnection)
            ->table('root_domains as d')
            ->join('root_accounts as a', 'a.id', '=', 'd.account_id')
            ->whereRaw('lower(d.host) = ?', [$host])
            ->whereNull('d.deleted_at')
            ->whereNotNull('d.verified_at')
            ->whereNull('a.deleted_at')
            ->whereNotNull('a.slug')
            ->value('d.account_id');

        return is_string($id) ? $id : null;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Data;

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;
use InvalidArgumentException;

#[Api(since: '1.0')]
final readonly class NormalizedHost
{
    public string $value;

    public function __construct(string $host)
    {
        if ($host === '' || $host !== trim($host) || str_contains($host, ':') || str_ends_with($host, '.')) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Host must be an unambiguous DNS hostname.');
        }

        $normalized = strtolower($host);

        if (! mb_check_encoding($normalized, 'ASCII') || strlen($normalized) > 253 || $normalized === 'localhost') {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Host must be a non-reserved ASCII hostname.');
        }

        $labels = explode('.', $normalized);

        if (count($labels) < 2 || array_any($labels, static fn (string $label): bool => preg_match('/^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/', $label) !== 1)) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Host must contain valid DNS labels.');
        }

        $this->value = $normalized;
    }

    public function __toString(): string
    {
        return $this->value;
    }
}

50→  нечем, тогда `account` легален.
- **`Access\WorkspaceScopeWiring`** — регистрирует `WorkspaceScope` (глобальный scope, приходит из
  `axiomasoft/corex-tenancy` по конфиг-пину `corex-access.workspace_scope_class`) на моделях с capability
  `workspace_scoped` автоматически при `boot()`; boxed-профиль без пина — тихий пропуск.
- **Известное ограничение профиля:** в дереве корневого проекта пока 0 сущностей с capability
  `ownable`/`workspace_scoped` — их раздача реальным продуктовым сущностям (CRM/Tasks) вне
  этого пакета.

- **`Identity\PrincipalUserProvider` — локальный лейн входа (D125)**: собственный
  `Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\UserProvider`, читающий пользовательскую таблицу через
60→  query-builder ЦЕЛИКОМ по конфигу `corex-access.identity` (`connection`/`table`/карта колонок
  `id`/`email`/`password`/`active`/`deleted_at`) и отдающий `Access\PrincipalIdentity(user,
  <id>)`. Пакет не импортирует ни одну модель `axiomasoft/corex-tenancy` — имя таблицы приходит строкой,
  тот же приём, что и `workspace_scope_class`. Это ЕДИНСТВЕННЫЙ шов, которым конструируется
  принципал-пользователь: облачный OIDC-лейн (`axiomasoft/corex-tenancy`, под `tenancy.oidc.enabled`)
  заканчивается штатным `Auth::loginUsingId($sub)`, который резолвится через ЭТОТ ЖЕ
  провайдер — так оба входа (локальный `Auth::attempt()` и облачный OIDC) собирают ровно один
  класс `Principal` (premortem C4). Чтобы включить лейн, приложение указывает драйвер в
  СВОЁМ `config/auth.php`:

70→  ```php
  'providers' => [
      'users' => [
          'driver' => 'corex-principal',
      ],
  ],
  ```

  Пакет никогда не пишет в `config('auth.*')` сам — драйвер регистрируется
  (`Auth::provider('corex-principal', …)`), проводка на гвард — дело приложения.

Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead.
